name: The Dominator Table
description: Sites of classical dependence in Mathlib ranked by how many theorems each is uniquely responsible for — the number that would stop depending on the axiom of choice if that site alone were rebuilt. Computed as a dominator tree over the reversed dependency graph rooted at the axiom, with chains of constants that free the same theorems collapsed to a single site.

measured.unit: sites, chains collapsed at a 0.97 weight ratio
